_meta.purpose: Labelled, dated reference data for a 'compare options' feature. Not advice, not a recommendation, no returns promised.
_meta.method: Public web search and page fetches only, no logins, no scrapers. Provider pages were not all reachable; many facts come from Which?/MoneyToTheMasses/DepositScout/university pages. Fields not verified are null with confidence 'unverified'.
gaps: Official provider pages were not fetched directly; international-student document requirements are mostly from university/student-union guidance and must be re-verified.
Monzo, Revolut, Chase, Wise student overdraft/perk details not covered by Which? article.
Remittance fee and FX margin figures are structural only; no live CNY/INR/HKD/SGD/USD->GBP quotes were obtained.
Bank of England 5 Nov 2026 decision is after the checked date.

council_tax.rule: Households where everyone is a full-time student are exempt. Course must last at least 1 year and involve at least 21 hours study per week. Mixed households may get a discount. A student visa alone does not guarantee exemption; part-time courses are generally liable unless 21 hours/week and 24 weeks is confirmed. University issues a certificate; the council decides.

tv_licence.rule: Needed to watch or record live TV or use BBC iPlayer. Halls: usually your own licence for your room. Shared house with a joint tenancy: one licence covers everyone; separate tenancies: each needs one. A home-address licence may cover a device running on battery only.
